security.message: The authorisations from "IS Manager" and "Program Coordinator" to "Secretary" over "I1: PersonalData" conflict on the authority to transfer authorisations
The authorisations from "IS Manager" and "Program Coordinator" to "Secretary" over "I2: FinancialStatus" conflict on the authority to transfer authorisations
"Student" requires "Program Coordinator" not to redelegate "G1: Write doc for I.O", and yet "Program Coordinator" delegates "G3: Get Student Record" to "Secretary"
"Student" requires "Program Coordinator" not to redelegate "G1: Write doc for I.O", and yet "Program Coordinator" delegates "G7: Write new doc" to "Secretary"
"Secretary" requires "IS Manager" single-actor redundancy for "G15: Obtain UTD Statement", but "IS Manager" doesn't decompose "G15: Obtain UTD Statement" into alternatives

"Student" authorises "IS Manager" on "I2: FinancialStatus" only for "G14: Get Student Pers. Data", but "IS Manager" produces "R7: Income Statement", which makes "I2: FinancialStatus" tangible, for "G15: Obtain UTD Statement"
